items.text: Pika detailed its Pika SFX model, which generates prompt-aligned, production-ready sound effects in under one second.
items.text_zh: Pika 详解 Pika SFX 模型，该模型可在一秒内生成符合提示词、达到制作级质量的音效。

items.text: Krea introduced Seedance Studio, combining Seedance 2.5 with prompt presets, camera paths and 3D scene controls in one creation workspace.
items.text_zh: Krea 推出 Seedance Studio，将 Seedance 2.5、提示词预设、镜头路径和三维场景控制整合到同一创作空间。

items.text: ElevenLabs released Eleven v3 Conversational for real-time applications, offering expressive audio controls and support for more than 70 languages.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 发布面向实时应用的 Eleven v3 Conversational，提供富有表现力的音频控制并支持超过 70 种语言。

items.text: Google AI Studio added GitHub synchronization, letting Build users import repositories and push or pull changes across environments.
items.text_zh: Google AI Studio 新增 GitHub 同步功能，Build 用户可导入代码仓库，并在不同环境间推送或拉取更改。

items.text: Vercel Agent can now join Slack threads with production context, create plans and pull requests, and roll back deployments.
items.text_zh: Vercel Agent 现可携带完整生产环境上下文加入 Slack 讨论，并能制定计划、创建拉取请求及回滚部署。

items.text: TrueFoundry open-sourced TrueForge, a vendor-neutral agent harness covering context management, MCP tools, subagents, sandboxing, approvals and persistent state.
items.text_zh: TrueFoundry 开源了厂商中立的智能体运行框架 TrueForge，涵盖上下文管理、MCP 工具、子智能体、沙箱、审批和持久状态。

items.text: Unsloth released Dynamic 3.0 GGUFs for Qwen3.8-27B, reporting over 10% better accuracy than competing quantizations on several benchmarks.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 发布 Qwen3.8-27B 的 Dynamic 3.0 GGUF 量化模型，并称其在多项基准上的准确率高出其他量化方案逾 10%。

items.text: Nvidia said open-source cuOpt became the fastest solver across three optimization classes in Hans Mittelmann’s benchmark suite.
items.text_zh: 英伟达表示，开源优化求解器 cuOpt 在 Hans Mittelmann 基准套件的三类优化问题中均取得最快成绩。

items.text: Nvidia introduced SkillEvaluator after benchmarking more than 300 verified skills to measure their effect on agents completing identical real-world tasks.
items.text_zh: 英伟达在测试逾 300 个认证技能后推出 SkillEvaluator，用于衡量不同技能对智能体完成相同真实任务的实际影响。

items.text: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Web Search added domain allowlists, blocklists and publication-date filters for more controlled agent retrieval.
items.text_zh: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 网页搜索新增域名允许列表、阻止列表和发布日期筛选，让智能体检索过程更可控。

items.text: Google Cloud open-sourced a zero-trust agent blueprint that assumes model compromise and enforces sensitive controls in infrastructure.
items.text_zh: Google Cloud 开源零信任智能体蓝图，以模型可能已被攻破为前提，并在基础设施层执行敏感操作控制。

items.text: Mem0 launched a Playground for testing and tuning what application agents remember and how strictly they retrieve stored memories.
items.text_zh: Mem0 推出 Playground，帮助开发者测试并调节应用智能体记住哪些内容，以及以多严格的条件检索记忆。

items.text: DeepSeek-V4-Pro High rose to second among open models in Agent Arena, with a reported 6% net improvement and $0.21 median task cost.
items.text_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro High 升至 Agent Arena 开放模型第二名，据报净胜率提升 6%，任务成本中位数为 0.21 美元。

items.text: Replit introduced a Free Mode designed to make its AI-assisted application creation workflow available without upfront usage costs.
items.text_zh: Replit 推出 Free Mode，旨在让用户无需预先承担使用费用即可体验其 AI 辅助应用创建流程。
